data.label: PTE Clinical CDEs
data.notes: Curated PTE Clinical CDE list, transformed from CSV exports under data/pte-clinical/ via scripts/transform-pte-clinical.mjs. CDEs are NINDS-attributed but disease-scoped to PTE; PTE-specific overlay columns (pte_domain, pte_class_notes, …) take precedence over the NINDS base values when populated.
